description: This file defines a class `BesselK` implementing the Excel BESSELK function, which computes the modified Bessel function Kn(x). It includes methods for calculation and handling array inputs, as well as internal methods for specific Bessel function cases.

classes.name: BesselK
classes.description: Provides methods to calculate the modified Bessel function Kn(x) for use within spreadsheet calculations, including support for array inputs and special case handling.

methods.name: BESSELK
methods.description: Calculates the modified Bessel function Kn(x) for given x and order, handling array inputs and error checking.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Determines the specific Bessel function value based on the order, delegating to specialized methods.

methods.name: callBesselI
methods.description: Internal method to call the BESSELI function from BesselI class correspondingly with error handling.

methods.name: besselK0
methods.description: Calculates K0(x) using a combination of approximation formulas for different ranges of x.

methods.name: besselK1
methods.description: Calculates K1(x) similarly with approximations suitable for x within specific ranges.

methods.name: besselK2
methods.description: Calculates Kn(x) for n > 1 using recursion from K0 and K1.
